title: allow the reviewer to write to its own role temp dir, as the prompt says it may

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261120-133801-8a30, project ork, item S449:

allow the reviewer to write to its own role temp dir, as the prompt says it may

Evidence: Write to /home/jon/.local/state/ork/t/8ae0a8bc5bac0fd2/3b735833065ebf2c/render_overlay_test.go denied: "Path is outside allowed working directories"

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions (2026-11-25): How should S510's empty Files, Failing tests, Implement and Check be filled in, and which roles get a temp-dir write grant? -> reviewer-only: only the reviewer gets an Edit/Write grant limited to its own role temp dir (cloud Claude and claude-local). Files: `internal/agent/claude/args.go`, `internal/agent/claude/pretool.go` and the reviewer's brief wording. Failing tests: a new `args_test.go` test asserting the reviewer's args hold `--add-dir TMPDIR`, `Edit(//TMPDIR/**)` and `Write(//TMPDIR/**)`, and a `pretool_test.go` case that allows a Write under TempDir and denies one outside it. Check: `go test ./internal/agent/claude` exits 0. [roles.read-only-temp-write].
